pins.title: Digital water governance at scale
pins.desc: CGIAR co-developed Agua de Honduras, a platform supporting water-resource management across 44% of the country, helping legalize 110 watershed councils and strengthen community-led water governance.

pins.title: Last mile in climate information services
pins.desc: CGIAR helped establish Guatemala's National Framework for Climate Services, delivering tailored climate information to farmers across five departments and 176 communities.

pins.title: Lower-emissions cattle production
pins.desc: A CGIAR-supported ranch achieved 44% lower emissions through sustainable grazing practices, helping attract US$7.5 million in private investment for scaling.
